faqs.question: What is the Plate Express® used for?
faqs.answer: It obtains mass spectra directly from TLC plates, combined with expression CMS to create the TLC/CMS technique, identifying compounds without additional sample preparation.

faqs.question: Does Plate Express work without expression CMS?
faqs.answer: No, it's specifically designed to work together with expression CMS; the combination creates the TLC/CMS technique.

faqs.question: How do I avoid overloading the mass spectrometer with a TLC sample?
faqs.answer: TLC spots naturally contain close to the ideal sample amount for mass spectrometry, so overloading isn't a risk you need to manage manually.

faqs.question: How do I operate Plate Express day to day?
faqs.answer: It's software-controlled, with spectra obtained within a few mouse clicks.

faqs.question: Is Plate Express suitable for a multi-user lab?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is an explicit design goal, simplifying the process specifically for labs where more than one person uses the instrument.

faqs.question: Can Plate Express identify compounds in complex mixtures?
faqs.answer: Yes, confident identification is confirmed even for complex, not just clean single-compound, samples.

faqs.question: What plate sizes does Plate Express support?
faqs.answer: This is confirmed directly by Inkarp based on your specific TLC plate format.

faqs.question: What is the price of the Plate Express® in India?
faqs.answer: The price depends on your existing expression CMS configuration. Contact Inkarp for a quotation once your setup is confirmed.

faqs.question: Who is the authorized distributor of the Plate Express® in India?

longForm.heroLead: A TLC plate tells you a spot is there. Plate Express tells you what it actually is, in under a minute, without a separate extraction and cleanup step first. Combined with expression CMS, it creates a genuine technique of its own: TLC/CMS. A TLC spot already contains close to the ideal sample amount for mass spectrometry, so there's no risk of overloading the detector the way a manually prepared sample sometimes carries. Software handles the rest, a few mouse clicks and the spectrum is ready. It's built specifically for labs where more than one person needs fast, confident compound identification from a plate they've already run, without training every user on manual sample prep for MS.

sections.title: Speed and Sample Sizing
body: Two things make TLC/CMS practical as a routine workflow, not just a clever trick: how fast it runs, and why it doesn't risk damaging the detector.

Identifying a spot takes under a minute, fast enough to check a TLC plate result as part of the normal workflow rather than as a separate analytical detour. The sample sizing question solves itself, too: a TLC spot already contains close to the ideal amount of material for mass spectrometry, so there's no need to worry about overloading the detector the way an improperly diluted manual sample might.
